displayIdentity.body: Calling holds circumcision, slavery, and freedom in place. Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies. Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.
displayIdentity.title: Calling holds circumcision, slavery, and freedom in place
